pages.title: Jelly Rancher
pages.text: $(bold)Base THC:$() 20% — $(bold)Base CBD:$() 5%$(br)$(bold)Effect:$() Dolphin's Grace (10 seconds)$(br)$(bold)Extra Effects:$() None (THC ≤ 20)$(br)$(br)Requires Cat Urine Bottle (right-click cat with glass bottle) and Tobacco.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Synthesizer Reagents:$()$(br)Cat Urine Bottle + Yellow Dye + Tobacco
Grind Jelly Rancher Buds in the Grinder (2 weed) or Manual Grinder (1 weed).
Plant on farmland or in a Grow Pot. Harvest at age 10. Get seeds via DNA route or Mutator.
Pack weed into a bag for selling to the Stoner Villager or compact storage.
